summary: Practise healthcare risk assessment, exposure controls and safety action planning. Review the five-day course outline and learning outcomes.
lede: Healthcare hazard control and safety management involves identifying, assessing and reducing workplace hazards across clinical and support services. For healthcare safety officers, clinical supervisors and infection prevention staff, the course develops practical skills in maintaining a hazard register, rating risks, choosing controls for biological, sharps and chemical exposures, and following up corrective actions; radiation protection and ergonomic and psychosocial risks receive introductory coverage.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for healthcare professionals who assess workplace hazards, coordinate safety controls or respond to exposure incidents across clinical and support settings.
outcomes: GHS Chemical Safety and SDS Control
modules: ISO 45001 Hazard Identification and Risk Assessment
GHS Chemical Safety and SDS Control
IAEA Radiation Protection in Clinical Work
prerequisites: No prior occupational health and safety qualification is required. Familiarity with healthcare work processes will help you apply the exercises to your role. No coding or programming is required.
